description: Read the B2B store's settings, as the B2B Store page under Setup shows them: its address (slug and full store URL), name, logo and colors, whether it is open to customers, whether browsing needs a sign-in, whether prices are shown, and the minimum order amount, plus how many customer logins and unaccepted invitations it has. configured=false means the store was never set up. Change settings with save_b2b_store_settings; see logins and invitations with list_b2b_customers. Requires an operator (unpinned) credential and the Admin role.
name: get_b2b_store_settings
title: B2B Store Settings
